name: Amy Food Inc
old_description: Amy Food Inc. is a family-owned food producer based in Houston, Texas, focused on frozen Asian-style appetizers. Its product line covers potsticker dumplings, egg rolls, crab rangoon, cream cheese wontons, empanadas and broth, with several items sold under the Jamy's Three Dragon label. about:
Amy Food Inc. operates from Houston, Texas, where it has spent three decades as a family-owned business. The company was founded on a passion for authentic Asian cuisine, though the exact founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures a line of frozen Asian-style appetizers that includes potsticker dumplings, egg rolls, crab rangoon, cream cheese wontons, empanadas and broth. Several items are sold under the Jamy's Three Dragon label. A notable capability is the in-house production of egg roll wrappers. Products are offered in pork, chicken and vegetable varieties, shipped frozen, and designed to be prepared by baking, deep frying, air frying or pan searing.

Amy Food serves both foodservice and retail channels. Its Jamy's Three Dragon products are distributed to restaurants, distributors and grocery retailers, though specific customer names are not provided.

The company states that its differentiation comes from blending time-honored recipes with meticulous care to deliver meals that taste like home, a philosophy that has guided its 30-year journey.
